Blink Marketing and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.

Blink Marketing is a marketing membership for real estate agents, and on some plans it posts to Facebook and Instagram for you [1][2]. VEXI makes posts, videos, designs and captions from what you ask for. The two overlap on social media and work in different ways.

Blink Marketing is a women-owned marketing membership built by top-producing real estate agents [1]. Members get posts, reels, captions, email newsletters, postcards, pop-bys, client events, listing presentations and lead capture pages, with new content every month, all editable in Canva [1][3]. Level 1 is $49 a month, or $29 a month paid once a year ($348), and you post the content yourself [2]. From Level 2 ($99 a month), Blink auto-posts to your Facebook and Instagram 5 times a week, and the Custom plans ($299 and $399 a month) add your logo, colors and headshot [2]. There is no contract, and you can cancel anytime [2].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
The two overlap on social media and work in different ways. Here is what each one does.
Blink’s team of agents writes fresh posts, reels, stories and captions every month in several social styles, and members can use them as they are or add their own branding in Canva [1][3].
VEXI makes content in your brand.

On the Custom plans, a Blink designer adds your headshot, colors and logo to every post, sends a branded mockup for your approval, and starts posting within 48 hours of your sign-off [2].

Plans run from $29 a month (Level 1, paid $348 once a year) to $399 a month (Level 3 Custom), billed month-to-month with no contract [2].
